scope: Descriptive named-style scalar contract; accept_named_style.py is the fail-closed paired validator

metrics.scope: Same-runtime monotonic clock and whole-runtime cumulative counters

worker-phase-1.json.points_array_order: Storage order differs from chronological order; index by unique phase name

capture-host.json.deadline: post_edit_deadline_monotonic_ms must equal edit_dispatched_monotonic_ms + 90000, with no extra export grace

memory-profile.json.requirements: Fresh distinct profile/addon, exactly one public persisted preference delta, effective readback matches, before-timed-gui, no GUI initialization

openracket-gui-phase-manifest.json.required: Native compilation zero; four identical stock GUI original_pins, exact common additive transformed sources and helper bytes/paths, exact production style pin at native clone-local resolved source; no unknown overlays

failure_policy: Preserve all partial files/logs; cancellation, OOM, timeout, missing/ambiguous endpoints, mismatched identity/counts, malformed data or skipped native gates never mean success.

activation.json.requirements: Existing phase-zero GUI, private style and annotation GUI namespaces before export inspection; actual editor style object class membership and successful private reader dispatch; resolved clone-local exact style source and common GUI source; only missing-export thunk can classify stock; candidate flag1/enabled true/state procedure, stock unset/missing exports; GUI handler thread; all other experiments absent

heartbeat.json.scope: One outstanding low-priority callback, closed-loop interval from previous handler; no physical input latency or typing claim
heartbeat.json.tail_gap: Frozen at stop against latest pre-stop handler or start; after-stop drain may update last_handler separately
heartbeat.json.success: No errors/drops/outstanding callbacks, joined producer, nonempty actual application-window coverage, exact timestamp arithmetic, post-join final validation inside original deadline

pair_acceptance.success: exit0, accepted true, failures empty, arms.stock.valid and arms.candidate.valid true
pair_acceptance.normalization: Only verified clone-relative typed module/hash/export/monitor identities; retain raw module paths and terminal association
pair_acceptance.source_deltas: Only exact owner-pinned style.rkt differs; all four original GUI inputs and common transformed modules equal
pair_acceptance.matrix_requirement: See CI-CONTRACT.json; three pairs/six fresh trial profiles and addons, full graph export plus normalized completed-work fields agree, every candidate actual-list activity witness accepted
pair_acceptance.numeric_contract: Reject booleans, nonfinite values, oversized exact timestamp integers and malformed/missing fields without losing other-arm or partial raw evidence

binding-export.json.export_contract: Nonempty mutable strong equal? hash, nonempty immutable strong equal? sets, exact in-range owning-editor endpoint triples; counts 1..300000, key_count<=edge_count; full sorted exact-integer quadruples written by Racket then SHA256. No raw payload in evidence.
binding-export.json.scope: Full public graph compatibility after ordinary readiness and heartbeat join; no first/second getter measurements, binding candidate state or latency bound
binding-export.json.final_recheck: verified_monotonic_ms <= post_export_final_verification_monotonic_ms < original deadline; current request/source/lexer are rechecked after full export validation
binding-export.json.failure: Partial scalar progress retained with verified false, status failed and bounded exception text when available

style-witness.json.state_contract: Immutable exact eight-field scalar hash; enabled true; no prewarming or synthetic named lookup; read-only export on actual get-style-list instance
style-witness.json.identity_contract: First list ID1; next ID1 or ID2. Same ID from after-open through final. Baseline before-open if same list else explicit replacement and after-open; never cross-instance subtraction
style-witness.json.activity_gate: Candidate ordinary-ready lookups and hits must strictly exceed selected same-instance baseline; natural startup warm state allowed; startup-only activity fails
style-witness.json.no_invented_invariants: No cross-counter equalities/ratios, global monotonicity, hits<=lookups, cache-valid=true, or successful-build accounting is assumed; traversals may include aborted builds
style-witness.json.preservation: All five absolute snapshots plus deltas for all six counts retained; failed/partial raw style evidence retained
